text: 11th November 2026 - Link Blog Browse tools.simonwillison.net by tag . I've been wanting a better way to browse my collection of vibe-coded tools (244 and counting) for a while. I had a few Fable 5.2 credits left over before my weekly reset so I set it to work using tree-sitter to analyze the code for JavaScript APIs, libraries, and web API hosts used by each tool. The homepage now features tag clouds for browsing by each of those categories of tag: This is a link post by Simon Willison, posted on 11th November 2026 .
